tonight.headline: Wilson ruled out; the lineup as set is the projection lineup
body: Bad news first. Garrett Wilson was ruled OUT for Kansas City on Friday (concussion; ESPN injury page citing the NY Post, 6 Nov). Bam Knight was ruled out too, which is good news: Allgeier is now Arizona's only established back, and ESPN moved him from 9.3 to 13.3.

AVIATO lead 8.9 to 5.58 after Thursday; ESPN projects 120.3 to 122.8, a 49% chance. This morning's Kamara swap is withdrawn — with Allgeier at 13.3 against Kamara's 11.3, the FLEX as you set it is already the projection's pick. Nothing to do before Sunday.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Talla Metralla start Burrow, Jonathan Taylor, Swift, Henry (5.6 Thursday) and Golden; Taylor faces Dallas. Your Monday pair, Allen and Jefferson (with Carson Wentz throwing), are the last word.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Sunday starter is inactive at the 90-minute list and the bench is not used — the only way 'nothing to do' turns wrong. No starter carries a designation tonight.

roster.footnote: Rows show the lineup as set at the 22:05Z snapshot: Allgeier in the FLEX, Wilson (OUT) and Kamara on the bench. Tuten played Thursday (8.9) and is locked. case.body: McCaffrey (hamstring) DNP Wednesday, back at practice Thursday and Friday (RotoBaller); no Friday designation found. Rotoworld: Black 'will continue to see a workhorse role' if McCaffrey sits.

case.label: The news

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 13.6 against Allgeier's 13.3: 0.3, a coin flip — and Allgeier is on the screen's exposure list. Starting him means dropping Kamara or Etienne for one week at Philadelphia.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Skattebo to IR or a multi-week timeline — then Singletary is a starter for weeks and worth Etienne's seat.
